params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly replaces hardcoded URI paths with a configurable parameter (`testTargetFolder`) obtained from system properties, addressing the SonarQube warning. The changes are limited to the relevant parts of the code related to path configuration and do not introduce unrelated modifications such as renaming variables or adding/removing print statements. The patch maintains the original logic and only adjusts the path handling to improve portability and testability.
